lineages.title: Local roots, two acquisitions, a new practice build
lineages.reading: Company ownership travels along one path. Duane’s later appointment is a people move, not another acquisition.

lineages.title: Build, sell, then build in a different ecosystem
lineages.reading: The continuity is in the founders. Versor’s data/AI track record does not become a Workday delivery claim.

lineages.reading: Payroll, Adaptive and local delivery appointments show how the practice is being assembled. They do not measure another firm’s losses.
